description: Constants Table for Stormwater Capture Dashboard is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. These metrics do not change on a regular basis. See Water Capture dataset for more dynamic information about stormwater capture in Los Angeles. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are sustainability, stormwater. The table has 9 columns. The portal shows 2018-07-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
